window.basis: call start time, local host clock

rule.success: A per 1,000 Bash calls is down >= 50 % vs the baseline in BOTH strata, and in each stratum the post count is below the 5th percentile of Poisson(baseline rate x post Bash calls), i.e. the drop beats count noise
rule.workaround_flat: in each stratum the post workaround count (sum of WA_KEYS) is at or below the 95th percentile of Poisson(baseline rate x post Bash calls); above it in either stratum = ROSE
rule.null_flat: in each stratum the post zsh `=` failure count lies inside the central 95 % Poisson interval of baseline rate x post Bash calls; outside it in either stratum = the population moved

verdicts.INSUFFICIENT: a stratum has fewer than min_post_bash_calls post Bash calls, or a zero baseline A count
verdicts.REMOVE-HOOK: the workaround detector ROSE (§11: remove the hook if workarounds rise)
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: the null moved, so a change in A cannot be attributed to the hook
verdicts.SUCCESS: success condition met, workarounds flat, null flat

rule.not_judged: B (call-hours) and gap forms (for loops, cd && prefixes) are reported only; they are legal by design

rebuild_reason: rebuilt the same day before any judgement: parser 1.5 treats heredoc bodies as data (1.4, frozen 12:13 and never used, counted edit scripts that merely mention sleep( or a wait script)
